dialogues.speaker: Galvana
dialogues.text: Hmm. Yes, it is definitely a potential danger. Would you also agree it would be better to seal it off?

dialogues.speaker: Galvana
dialogues.text: The searchlights seem to break frequently. It might be because of the energy storage devices installed inside them.

dialogues.speaker: Galvana
dialogues.text: Or maybe they break so often because people don't follow the instructions when they use them?

dialogues.speaker: Galvana
dialogues.text: Hmm. Now that I think about it, it's not that small a space. It would be great if we could put it to good use...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm in favor of sealing up all entrances and exits.

dialogues.speaker: Galvana
dialogues.text: Seal up all the entrances and exits? That's a little extreme... I never thought you would advocate doing something like that. You really can't judge a book by its cover...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There's someone who looks just like you...

dialogues.speaker: Galvana
dialogues.text: You've met Galvaryet? She's my younger sister. We're twins. *ahem* She's too old to keep calling me Sis all the time...

dialogues.speaker: Galvana
dialogues.text: Oh, please don't take it the wrong way. I don't dislike her at all, it's just... This is our workplace, and we should be more serious when it's work hours!
